title: Limit of a Learning Rate Schedule

description:
Determine asymptotic mathematical limit lim_{t -> infty} eta(t) for exponential, cosine, step, and constant learning schedules.

Stochastic approximation guarantees convergence to local minima if sum(eta_t) = infty and sum(eta_t^2) < infty, requiring lim eta_t = 0.

### Mathematical Formulation
$$
\lim_{t \to \infty} \eta(t) = \begin{cases} \eta_0 & \text{if constant} \\ 0 & \text{if exponential, cosine, or decaying} \end{cases}
$$

### Step-by-Step Implementation
1. Check schedule family type
2. Evaluate theoretical asymptotic mathematical limit as time steps t -> infty
3. Return scalar limit rounded to 6 decimal places

### Returns
Float representing asymptotic learning rate limit.
